snippet.title: Restaurant Scramble - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Restaurant Scramble now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3906780/Restaurant_Scramble

Restaurant Scramble is a short and sweet incremental game about running a restaurant. Begin with only a cheeseburger to sell, but grow your menu so that your customers can choose from a variety of food.

Update your menu: change out your menu constantly to keep customers happy

Grow the skill tree: upgrade your production speed, happiness and more to keep up with the growing demands of customers!

Unlock up to 4 unique restaurants, each with their own rules, but each with more potential for profit! Watch the big numbers get bigger!

Wishlist now on Steam, or playtest on Itch at https://windiertag.itch.io/restaurant-scramble-playtest
